== Notes ==
* If a foe hexed with Rising Bile [[Death|dies]], all foes in the area will be damaged. (As with [[Parasitic Bond]], the game counts the hex as ''ended'' if the target dies.)
* Re-casting Rising Bile has no effect. It will still expire after the initial 20 seconds.

== Trivia ==
